versions.changelog:
- Added English and Chinese README files (README.en.md, README.md) for broader documentation support.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md documentation file.
- No changes to core features or functionality.

- Updated branding: API requests now carry "AI公众号信息源-SkillHub" instead of "AI公众号信息源-GitHub".
- Removed built-in public API key; users must now manually configure their API Key before use.
- Updated instructions to focus on API Key configuration via environment variable, file, or command-line parameter.
- Simplified usage documentation, removing references to features no longer supported.
- Deleted documentation files: README.md, README.en.md, skill-card.md.

- Added English and Chinese README files for improved documentation.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- Updated API request identifier from `AI公众号信息源-ClawHub` to `AI公众号信息源-GitHub`.
- Added support for specifying a custom time range with `--start-time` and `--end-time`.
- Changed environment variable for API key configuration from `X_API_KEY` to `REDFOX_API_KEY`.
- Clarified API key usage and priority in documentation.

- Initial release of gzh-ai-feed skill.
- Automatically scans and curates hottest AI WeChat public account articles by read count.
- Clusters articles into daily topics and generates styled HTML reports with cover images, metrics, and easy navigation.
- Includes built-in search across all articles and supports one-click daily subscription.
- Zero-config usage with 10,000 free API requests; personal token setup available after quota is used.
